summary: Full review iteration 9 — exercised all admin menus and the kader home-visit flow against the live preview backend/frontend. 52/52 backend pytest cases pass (auth, mode PIN, master data CRUD, dashboard KPI/charts/jawaban/insights/rekap-kader, kasus, tindak-lanjut, kader mgmt, import templates, laporan preview + export CSV/Excel/PDF for 4 report types, audit, notifikasi, akreditasi, and the full kader flow: login → beranda → list keluarga → create keluarga + anggota → submit kunjungan → admin visibility → cleanup). Frontend sanity: admin login + navigation through all 9 admin menus with no API errors and no console/page errors; both Dashboard tabs render; kader11 login lands on Beranda with correct wilayah (Seroja · Selat Tengah), bottom nav (Beranda/Keluarga/Kunjungan/Tugas/Profil) all clickable.

design_issues.screen: Admin Dashboard filter + any date input
issues: Uses browser-native date picker (type=date, placeholder 'mm/dd/yyyy') instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover component — inconsistent with design system and locale (expected dd/mm/yyyy).

React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — some Select renders a <span> inside a native <option>. Non-breaking but should be cleaned (use plain text inside <option> or move to shadcn Select).

action_items: (Low) Replace native date inputs in Admin Dashboard filter with shadcn Calendar/Popover and use dd/mm/yyyy locale.

(Low) Remove the <span> inside <option> that triggers the React hydration warning in Dashboard 'Hasil Jawaban & Kesimpulan' (likely one of the Select dropdowns like 'Top N', 'Semua kelompok', 'Semua prioritas', or 'Urut: tanda bahaya dulu').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1963 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, master, keluarga, kunjungan, kasus, laporan, admin_import, akreditasi, dashboard) for maintainability.
/api/keluarga list runs per-row count_documents for anggota and kunjungan (N+1). For large datasets this will be slow — prefer aggregation with $lookup or pre-computed counts.
mode PIN is stored in DB settings via hash_password, but default seed assumed to be '123456' — ensure seed is idempotent and never logs the plain PIN. (Not retested here.)

Dashboard KPI shows 'Cakupan Kunjungan 108.7%' — denominator vs numerator mismatch (keluarga_dikunjungi > keluarga_terdaftar). Verify formula clamps at 100% or uses the correct base (terdaftar vs seharusnya dikunjungi).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all 9 admin menus + both dashboard tabs + kader beranda/keluarga/tugas/profil load with 0 API errors)
